notes.title: Minor Update - Super bosses and Seated Mode
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings adventurers!  [/h1]
[h2]It's time for another massive RFVR 'minor' update[/h2]
[h3]This update brings a whole lot of new content - enemies, quests, and possibly most important of all, a seated mode[/h3]

Here's a brief rundown of many of the changes:

[h3][b]Super Enemies[/b][/h3]
-We've added 'Super Bosses' and 'Super Mobs' Be prepared for an increased difficulty in every area, Super Bosses are indicated by their bright pink colored level and healthbar, while super mobs are identifiable by their bright red level and health bar.
-Super Bosses are guaranteed to drop one 'Super Item' which is a special armor, weapon, spell, bow, firearm, or throwing weapon bag that has increased and potentially godly stats.
-Super Bosses spawn with one of nine special stat bonuses which are chosen at random and impart their special stats onto their mob members.  Super Bosses receive an increase to all base statistics in addition to their special stat bonus.[list]
[*] -[b]Extra Strong:[/b] Greatly increased HP and increased damage
[*] -[b]Extra Fast:[/b] Greatly increased movement Speed and attack speed
[*] -[b]Extra Resistant:[/b] Greatly increases all resistances
[*]-[b]Fire Enhanced:[/b] Deals fire damage to all players within the radius every 5 seconds
[*]-[b]Ice Enhanced: [/b]Slows movement speed of all players within the radius for 5 seconds every 5 seconds
[*]-[b]Poison Enhanced: [/b]Deals poison damage to all players within the radius every 5 seconds
[*]-[b]Shock Enhanced: [/b]Deals shock damage to all players within the radius every 5 seconds
[*]-[b]Holy Enhanced:[/b] Heals self and all allies within the radius every 5 seconds
[*]-[b]Dark Enhanced:[/b] Explodes a nearby dead body and deals dark damage to all players within the radius every 5 seconds
[/list]
[h3][b]Armor Stat Updates[/b][/h3]
    -we've done an update to armor stats that makes better equipment a bit more common and rare/legendary armors now have even more impressive stats. 
[h3][b]Lighting adjustments[/b] [/h3]
    -for improved daytime shadows and darker nights, to compensate for the slightly lower visibility at night we've added a new light to all torches that is enabled when held or placed in the body storage.
[h3][b]Melee Slashing Attack homing update[/b][/h3]
    -The Melee 'Slashing attack' is now a homing projectile that seeks out enemies
[h3][b]Wrapping up Mystveil quests with an epic reward[/b][/h3]
    -The Mystveil temple has been packed with new ideas and unique quest rewards, for those who make it this far we've prepared a very special reward
[h3][b]Press Trigger to use Salvage Potions[/b][/h3]
-new way to activate the salvage potions
[h3][b]Legendary Smithing Hammers[/b][/h3]
-elemental smithing hammers now give higher smithing bonus. 
[h3][b]New enemies[/b][/h3]
-A new type of enemy that has a second 'super' phase that engages at below 50% hp
[h3][b]and FINALLY, Seated Mode![/b] [/h3]
-enable seated mode either in the game settings menu or use hot key F7


[b]
As always we really hope you are enjoying your time in the game and look forward to hearing any feedback and suggestions.



-OMFGames[/b]

notes.title: Crash fix and minor update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings adventurers,[/h1]
We're pushing an update today with a very important crash fix and some other minor updates.
For those of you who were experiencing the crash, we sincerely thank you for your patience and continued support, especially with testing the crash fixes. We are confident now that the demonic entity that was plaguing our code has been fully exorcised! We apologize if you were impacted by this bug and we'd love to make it up to you - 

[h2]With that out of the way, what else is new in this update?[/h2]
[b]Strength and Insight class specific modifiers[/b] - To balance the gameplay a bit we've added an enhanced modifier for your character classes and made this modifier visible on weapons and spells. Warriors now deal additional melee damage (Weapon Damage + 2x player Strength), while mages deal additional spell damage (Spell damage + 2x player insight).
[b]Loot Spawn Update[/b] - several enemies were spawning items at various heights, we've standardized the spawn location, and no longer simulate physics for any spawned items so they will not fly away in an explosion.
[b]Spawn Optimization[/b] - As part of the crash fix, we've implemented an entirely new spawn/despawn logic from scratch with much more optimized logic.  Expect some nice performance improvements here.

notes.title: RFVR Major Update #6
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IDLA11sWRQw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]It's Time For Major Update 6[/b][/h1]

[h2]We're excited to bring you an update just in time for the winter sale![/h2]

[h3]As always there is a huge amount of new content, let's start with what's new[/h3]

[b]Mystveil Temple[/b] - A new town inhabited by the Shinobi and a group of scholars studying the ancient history of the island. Here you can take part in the Shinobi Trials to unlock a new sub-class.  The Shinobi sub-class grants double jump and a huge damage bonus to throwing weapons. A new smithing quest line will also teach you how to use the sharpening stone to make your melee weapons capable of launching a projectile slashing attack! 

[b]Firearm Overhaul[/b] - Bullets needed a new solution and with this update they got one. Firearm projectiles now function a great deal better (especially firing and moving forward)

[b]Boss Battles[/b] - Two brand new boss battles have been added and will be found through the main quest line. These bosses present new unique types of challenges, best be prepared

[b]New Relics[/b] - It wouldn't be a major update without some powerful new Relic items! 

[b]New Enemies[/b] - Several new enemies including a flying dragon and an undead shinobi!

[b]Melee Combat Overhaul[/b] - We're extra excited to see the melee combat coming together better than ever, reworked a lot of the code to make hits better and more impactful as well as improving the physics and AI behaviors of the enemies.  No more crowding too close.

[b]New core spells[/b] - [b]Purify remains[/b], a spell that allows you to purify a dead enemy for some HP.  [b]Summon Skeleton[/b], a spell that allows you to summon a skeleton follower from enemy remains.

[b]New Music Tracks and Audio Engineering[/b] - We continue to expand our playlist of music and have done some fun new things with audio that we think you'll all enjoy

[h3]Other Fixes and Improvements[/h3]

[b]Items Falling Through Map Fix[/b] - Items will no longer fall through the map unexpectedly.

[b]Stuck Weapons Solution[/b] - No more weapons stuck in things! Ever! A nice quality of life improvement, if an item is stuck just pull it away and it should automatically unstick.


[h2]Important Note[/h2]

Due to some of the recent changes, we've noticed that some saved games may randomly trigger a bug that we're still tracking down that causes a fatal error and game crash.  We recommend starting new characters to avoid this crash but from what we gather the crash only seems to happen once and its somewhat random.


[h3]As always we look forward to hearing your feedback and suggestions, join us on the discord or start up a steam discussion thread.  Stay tuned for more amazing RFVR content![/h3]

-OMFGames

notes.title: RFVR - Major Update 5
notes.notes:
[h1]It's time for the next Major Update to RFVR Early Access.  As always we have a metric crap ton of new content, skills, abilities, quests, enemies, relics and everything else you need.[/h1]

[previewyoutube=d3KFNpt5LBI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Major Highlights of this update include[/b][/h2]

[h3][u]Voice Recognition:[/u] [/h3]Talk to NPCs, Cast spells and more.  Most NPC's can be engaged with a greeting then respond to certain key words and might provide some useful knowledge.  There are some voice activated skills that unlock at certain levels like Wind (level 40) and Incinerate (level 60). You can also use voice commands to instruct any party members to wait in place or return to following. Utility spells can be cast by voice, and a few relic spells as well.
[h3][u]Catacombs:[/u] [/h3]Small cave systems with puzzles, enemies, and precious loot!  More of these to come in the near future
[h3][u]New Town/Quests/Enemies/Items:[/u][/h3] All geared specially for players level 50 through 70, prepare to be challenged and rewarded.  Merchants Cove provides new association quests, while the Pirate docks provide a few unique new opportunities, the pirate sub-class, and the shipping boat.
[h3][u]Performance Optimizations:[/u][/h3] Part of our never ending struggle to give you the best performing RFVR as usual, per the contact between Dev and Man.
[h3][u]Pillars of Power:[/u][/h3] New pillars to unlock!
[h3][u]Relics:[/u][/h3]Two new relic rooms with shiny relics you'll want to have.
[h3][u]Pirate Sub-Class:[/u][/h3] Complete the pirate trial and become a Pirate along with all the unique class benefits - double damage with all firearms, and 5X gold pickup.
[h3][u]Shipping Boat:[/u] [/h3]New boat for sale that acts as a mobile save location and holds 4 long term storage chests, only available to pirate class customers.
[h3][u]New Business:[/u][/h3] Become the owner of the Merchants Cove Shipping business and use your fancy new boat to make deliveries for big gold payments.  Too busy to fill out the paperwork? Hire the advisor to manage that for a small fee.
[h3][u]Godstone:[/u] [/h3]The next tier of crystals are now available, allowing you to craft tier 6 through tier 10 spells and imbue weapons with a new debuff effect.

Also...So much more its hard to keep track of it all, join our discord for all the latest and greatest and as always we welcome your feedback and suggestions.

Peace out
OMFGames

notes.title: RFVR Major Update #4 - Party Quests and More
notes.notes:
[h1]- Greetings Adventurers - [/h1]
[h2]Major Update #4 is now live on the main branch[/h2]
[h3]This Update is centered on multiplayer gameplay and questing[/h3]

[previewyoutube=xyrRifQGpTw;full][/previewyoutube]
This video is showing off mostly gameplay from the client player perspective

[h3]We've made a ton of progress improving the multiplayer co-op experience.[/h3] 

There is a new quest system in place for small (2-3 players) and large (4-5 players) sized parties in which players share EXP and earn quest rewards. Party quests are currently available in three locations targeting levels 1-10, 10-20, and 20-30+, and vary from "Assault" to "Defense" and "Boss Fight". In addition there is a new revive function that allows party members to heal fallen team mates by standing next to them for 3 full seconds. Multiplayer is still a work in progress and there are some odds and ends that may not work as expected for clients, please drop us a line and let us know if you find any issues.

[h3]We've added other content and improvements[/h3]
Quality of life improvements: 
-We've made the griping and climbing mechanics a lot more reliable and easy to use.
-We've made the flight spell free and available for all levels from the start of the game

New Content:
-Several new challenging enemies (level 40+)
-New ruins/temple area
-Tier 2 loot chests, be on the lookout for the second tier of loot chests which can provide equipment up to level 79!

[b]As always we appreciate all of the input and feedback we receive, don't be afraid to reach out!

Cheers,
OMFGames[/b]

notes.title: RFVR Major Update #3
notes.notes:
[h1][b]The third major update to RFVR is now available.  [/b][/h1]
[previewyoutube=hxmtkaH4X3g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Come explore challenging new biomes and obstacles.  New enemies, new weapons, new spells, new relics, new followers, new quests and much more.[/h2]

[h3]This update is a continuation of the main quest and story-line and adds a ton of new features along with performance improvements. This update primarily includes new quests, enemies, and items, for player levels 40 through 60+

[b]Apprentices[/b]: 2 new followers, Fighter and Caster Apprentice, that level up along with you and can be equipped with armor and weapons or spells. Each apprentice also includes additional storage space for all you hoarders. Available in the city of Ironhold at level 50

[b]New Biomes[/b]: New areas with challenging obstacles and dangerous atmospheres.

[b]Enemies[/b]: New enemies and new tiers of enemies

[b]Weapons/Armor/Spell[/b]: New tiers of weapons, armors and spells!

[b]Advisors[/b]: Tired of doing all that paperwork?  Once you reach a certain 'status' you can hire adivsors to do your business paperwork for a 10% cut

[b]Relics[/b]: 4 new relics you are going to want.
[b]
Profession quests[/b]: New Mining and Smithing quests and items.

[b]Crafting[/b]: New tiers of Armor/Bow/Weapon/Spell Crafting

[b]Flight Speed Limit[/b]: Slightly slower but more controlled impulse flight, and a secret hidden item to break you out of the speed limiter.

[b]Quality of life and performance improvements[/b]: Thanks to user feedback for all the great suggestions and help identifying issues.[/h3]

And much more, we recently updated the demo as well with tons of new features, give it a try and stay tuned for more.

notes.title: April Minor Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,
It's time to release the next minor update to RFVR, this video gives a quick run down of some of the updates you'll see

[previewyoutube=6X25OmD7vy4;full][/previewyoutube]

-Music: We've added several hours of new music to the world along with new 'music biomes' such as towns and caves that have their own unique soundtracks.

-Melee Combat: We've updated the sounds and visual effects across the board for melee weapons, sounds for picking up/dropping have also been added.

-Pillars of Power: An exciting new addition, the 'signal towers' have been overhauled and are now ancient pillars of power that provide a sweet bonus if you complete the challenge. 

-Storyline: We've began to build and evolve a 'main' storyline into the world which will tie the relic rooms and pillars of power into an epic planned end game.  

-Fortress City Under Way:  If you've made it to the 'end' of the early access quest line you may find that the fortress city marketplace is being built out, feel free to explore and use the new tiers of items, crafting, upgrading and more. Expect the fortress city to be complete with the next Major update probably sometime in June or July.

As always we are delighted to hear your feedback and suggestions to help improve RFVR, Please reach out to us!

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/Nxw4VZP9kD

notes.title: RFVR - Major Update #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Adventurers. [/h1]

[h3]We are ready to release our second major update to RFVR and this one is huge.
Along with a large amount of user feedback we've added and updated a ton of content. 
Check out the highlights here and read below for more info [/h3]
[previewyoutube=KKoka12avQg;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]
Performance improvements: [/b][/u]We worked really hard to stabilize performance and we have optimized a great deal without sacrificing quality. Expect some hitches here and there especially when moving fast but solid FPS otherwise.

[u][b]Combat and enemy physics updates:[/b][/u] We are very happy with the improvements to combat, enemies now detect the players and respond significantly better.  A knock back effect has been added which greatly improves the weight and feel of your melee hits.  Animated blood damage effects have been added for many of the enemies and is still a work in progress.
[u][b]
Purchase and manage businesses: [/b][/u]There are 4 businesses currently that you can own and manage. Managing includes completing the daily tasks and filling out the invoice paperwork. There's a Bar, a Delivery Service, a Marketplace, and an Inn, each with their own unique tasks.  It's a great way to earn some extra income!

[b][u]New settlement added, Port 3:[/u][/b] A new town with quests and adventures awaits 

[b][u]Throwing Weapons with Aim Assist:[/u][/b] We have added an array of throwing weapons to RFVR. Additionally there is a new buildable building in the Port 3 town that provides special throwing weapon packs as well as an enchanting station for adding elemental damage to your throwing weapons. A ton of fun to master!

[u][b]Countless quality of life improvements: [/b][/u]Too many to list here but our users have so many great ideas for fixing and improving things in the world, hats off to them for all their efforts. We really couldn't have made this game so great without you.

Join us on discord to chat and offer up your suggestions and feedback, we'd love to hear from you.
https://discord.gg/EZfGVh9SKb

Check out our TikTok and Twitter for updates as well
https://www.tiktok.com/@rfvrgaming
https://twitter.com/rfvrofficial

notes.title: RFVR Major Update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We are proud to announce the first major update to the RFVR Early Access! [/b] [/h1]

[h2][i]First a huge thank you to all of our users and supporters for helping us make RFVR a great game, we <3 you.[/i][/h2]

This update is the culmination of over 3 months of development progress and brings with it a slew of new experiences to RFVR. The users asked us for updates to NPCs and NPC interactions and and that's exactly what Update#1 delivers. We estimate to be about 25% complete with the early access development at this time and are on target for an end of year 2023 finish of Early Access and into the Full Release. If you've played the game then you know just how massive it is already and for how much there is available to do it's hard to imagine we're only 25% of the way there.  This update just about brings quadrant 1 of the map to a close for now, the next update will focus on the next quadrant and we have some really awesome things in store.  

Check out the overview of this update here
[previewyoutube=T0qhKmObPRc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's what you can expect to see in Update #1

[h3][b]Mercenaries and Adventure Parties: [/b][/h3]You can now hire a variety of mercenaries to join along in your adventures, as well as team up different with adventure parties spread across the world.  Join and interact with over 15 new and unique NPC adventurers which all have their own personalities and special abilities. Adventurers and Mercenaries come in a variety of ranged or melee attack styles and bring a whole new dimension to exploration.  

[h3][b]NPC Townsfolk:[/b][/h3] New dialog and quests have been added throughout the first quadrant of the map.  Help the local townsfolk complete various tasks for unique and sometimes hefty rewards. NPC's will have you traveling to areas of the map you didn't even know existed. Additionally, new daily lifecycle behaviors have been added to all Townsfolk. 

[h3][b]Improved Town Guards:[/b][/h3] The guards were missing a lot of their attacks and frankly not very effective. We've given them that much needed attention and now you can expect those town guards to be able to fight well during town attacks, especially if you take the time to upgrade them.

[h3][b]Growing, Breeding, and Smoking Herbs:[/b][/h3] Now you can be just like your favorite fantasy wizard with this revolutionary new mechanic in RFVR. 8 special varieties of herbs have been added throughout the map and can be grown within special herb boxes. Herb plants can be cross pollinated up to three times, enhancing their potency and effects. Herbs are then consumed with a wizard pipe and offer temporary bonus's to strength, insight, and resistances.

[h3][b]New Tutorial:[/b] [/h3] More detailed and thorough tutorial is now provided to new players in the great hall starting area and the tutorial is able to be toggled on or off at any level.

[h3][b]Boat Upgrade:[/b] [/h3]Tired of getting stuck in the middle of the shallow sea after your boat hit a small wave and exploded? We've made the boat a lot more durable and forgiving. If you do still happen to break the boat, a boat hull and enough materials to build a new boat will spawn in it's place.

[h3][b]Purchasable Homes:[/b][/h3] You can now purchase and own 4 different homes in RFVR. Each home comes with a variety of useful tools, a save location, and an additional long term storage chest! Hoarders be aware! Many more purchasable homes are on the way!

[h3][b]Wood Crafting:[/b][/h3] Now available for crafting Wooden Wizard Pipes, Boat Hulls, and Herb Boxes

[h3][b]Leather Crafting:[/b] [/h3]New item 'Food Pouch' can be crafted and increases food item storage.

[h3][b]Advanced Armor Smithing: [/b] [/h3]A new tier of armor smithing has been added. Trust us, you're going to need the bonus to resistances you get from this vendor in the very near future.

[h3][b]Shoulder Holster Text:[/b] [/h3]Previously, It could be a bit difficult to grab shoulder holstered weapons. Now, you are prompted with text when your hand overlaps a holstered weapon, or when a weapon overlaps a holster. 

[h3][b]Continued Profession Quests[/b][/h3]  New Farming and Smithing quest tiers have been added.

[h3][b]New Enemies[/b][/h3] Added a few new enemy species.

[h3][b]Various Bug Fixes, enhancements, and optimizations:[/b] [/h3]Fixed issues with Torch lighting, Ore Satchel and other storage pouch item persistence, Cooked food bowl item persistence, and too many more to list here. Thanking our players and our Discord users again here for all the feedback they provide, we probably wouldn't find some of these bugs without your help. Lighting improvements and performance optimizations.

Stayed tuned for the next major update, we're already getting started and we can't wait to share the progress.  Join our [url=https://discord.gg/EZfGVh9SKb]Discord[/url] to get access to the beta as soon as its live and chat with us, share you thoughts, suggestions, and help us keep improving on RFVR.

notes.title: August Update is Live
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings!  [/b]

We have just launched our August update on the main branch and there's so much new content.  I'll highlight some of them here quickly.

[b]Arena Mode[/b] -  A brand new multiplayer level has been added to RFVR.  The level consists of a central castle and a surrounding forest littered with enemies.  Players can spawn waves of different enemies within the castle. Keep in mind this is a sandbox level, no progress is stored or saved in arena mode currently. 

[b]Lost and Found[/b]  - Items that fall through the landscape are teleported to the Lost and Found located in the great hall starting area

[b]Leather Crafting[/b]  - A new station has been added to a few towns on the island where players can craft 2 new storage items, the Ore Satchel, and the Builder Bag. More leather crafted items coming soon

[b]Shoulder Holsters[/b]  - Each shoulder can now be equipped with a melee weapon for quick access. These weapons save and persist with your character.

[b]Multiplayer Level Parity[/b] - The multiplayer level is now fully up to date with the single player level and multiplayer game performance is greatly improved for both client and server.

[b]New Blood Effects[/b] - Added blood spatter from slicing and blunt force attacks, as well as arterial bleeding from stabs and penetrating attacks.  

[b]Full Body Updates[/b] - We've updated the VR body to be better aligned with the player, and greatly improved the experience while playing with the body visible

You can check out all the updates in the video below.
[previewyoutube=zC3Um7pKAVw;full][/previewyoutube]


Our focus for the next month or two will now be on making the next major update.  The scope of this next update is going to be centered around NPCs, their behavior, and their interactions. The updates we've got planned are mostly based on suggestions from all of you. We also plan to continue the main quest line and quests for each profession, We'll also be adding new enemies, relics, and more difficult challenges in the second quadrant of the island.  There will be content for both new and experienced players alike.  


Be sure to reach out to us if you have any issues.  We also would love to hear any suggestions or feedback you have.  [b]Join our discord https://discord.gg/EZfGVh9SKb [/b]for the most up to date information any time and we look forward to bringing you more exciting content to RFVR.

notes.title: Early Access Content Update #2
notes.notes:
Here's a look at what's new in the update 
[b]Leather Crafting:[/b] There is now a station in the merchant square of the first two towns to perform leather crafting.  Currently you can only craft the Ore Satchel as the other crafting items are still in development/testing. Different animal hide allows certain items to be crafted
[b]Ore Satchel:[/b]  This item will hold up to 8 ores within it, just touch a held ore to the bag and it will be stored inside, press trigger to remove all stored items. If the satchel is empty you can hold trigger and touch any crystal ore to store it inside the bag as well.
[b]Lost and Found: [/b] We've added a lost and found to the great hall, as well as a way to get back to the great hall from the adventure association buildings. Any items that fall through the map should return to the lost and found.
[b]Save Game:[/b]  Moved the location of the save game so you no longer have to go upstairs and fight with the small space to move around in the attic.
[b]AI behavior updates: [/b]Nothing too major but enemy AI will now alert other nearby enemies if they detect a player. We've also made some adjustments to the detection to make it harder to sneak around
[b]Visual Enhancements:[/b] More tweaking of the world colors, materials, and grading of the scene to improve the visuals
Performance Optimizations: Increased performance on all tested video cards.

Notable Fixes/changes
Spell Crafting exploit fixed
Enemies getting blocked from movement by ragdoll bodies fixed
Hammer Level 3 grip physics issues resolved
Mana and HP crystal Relics must be held in hand to activate for now
Werewolf was given a ranged attack
2 New enemy species added the map
2 New Relic Rooms

Many more improvements to RFVR are in progress and the way, stay tuned and join our discord for the most up to date information.  Thanks for playing RFVR!

notes.title: RFVR Demo Now Available - User Feedback Update Is Out
notes.notes:
[h1][b]The Demo Is Live[/b][/h1]

[b][h2]Greetings![/h2][/b]
[h3]You may have noticed the RFVR Demo became available last week. We have already compiled a great list of feedback and suggestions and pushed the first update to the demo. Join the discord or leave a comment in the steam community to provide suggestions and feedback any time. We've received a lot of responses about the player movement being too fast. If you are on the Index or Oculus controllers, remember, run/walk is toggled by clicking in the left thumb stick.  Walking speed is much easier to control indoors and the new acceleration updates also improve the mobility[/h3]

[h3][b]Note:
Your saved game should persist through the updates and into the early access release.
[/b][/h3]

[h3]Here's a quick breakdown of the main improvements in the first update.[/h3]

[olist]
[*]Reduced player acceleration to make the movement feel more natural and less instantaneous. 
[*]Another movement option added in the settings menu for headset oriented movement.
[*]Smooth-turn option added in the settings menu. 
[*]All items 'Grip' to grab, for consistency all items will be grip to pick up.
[*]The body storage area size is increased. More room for all your goodies and easier storage.
[*]Improved tutorials in game. We recognize that some mechanics are a bit confusing at first so we've added tutorials in game to help close the gaps.
[*]Player and Graphics settings now persist after exit, just remember to save your game!
[/olist]

We plan to hold off on early access release until we've received all the feedback and integrated the fixes/suggestions to the demo. Expect to see the updates to the demo pushed as needed until release.

For now, enjoy the demo, keep an eye out for new updates, and know that we will be here to respond to feedback and answer questions.  


-OMFGames
